1 · Your website and online ordering

Your guests order from you, not from an app

Your menu (all dishes, your prices) on a site built like ours. Order something, or book catering trays: every step works, and the guest's phone on the right shows the texts they would get.

Try this

  • Add a dish to the order
  • Check out and pay
  • Watch the ready text arrive
  • Book and pay for catering trays
  • Ask Haniya a question on the site

Everything you do here also shows up in your Haniya app and dashboard tabs.

Your photos, our standard

Your own photo, re-shot the way every dish on your menu would look. The food is untouched; only the light and the table change.

2 · The phone

Every call answered, even in the rush

Haniya picks up as , knows your whole menu and your hours, takes the order and texts the guest a pay link. The food is only made once it's paid. Haniya is our host; yours can have its own name, face and voice. Pick a call to play.

    3 · Your Haniya app

    Ask your restaurant a question, get the answer

    This is your app, not a guest's. It opens on the questions you would ask, already answered. Type or speak in your own language. For anything that reaches guests or costs money she asks you first, and you can undo it.

      4 · Your dashboard

      The whole business on one screen

      The same dashboard we run our own restaurant on: Home, Analytics, Phone and Ordering up front, the rest under More. Switch between today, 7 days, 30 days and the year. These are sample numbers made from your menu and prices; with you live, it fills from your till every few minutes.

      5 · What it's worth

      What this is worth to you each month

      Every slider starts at our estimate from what we could see of your restaurant. Move them to your real numbers and the total updates.
